paragraphs.text: The whole people were witnesses to his holy majesty in adopting them, and of his mighty power in delivering them.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Seeing that these dead creatures felt God's power and after a sort saw it, much more his people ought to consider it, and glorify him for the same.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Ought then his people to be insensible when they see his power and majesty?
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: That is, miraculously caused water to come out of the rock in great abundance, Ex 17:6.
paragraphs.label: e
paragraphs.anchor: turned the rock into a standing
